CustomField.description: How many times the same error must appear inside the date range you are viewing before the Log Console groups it into Problem summary. The default of 2 keeps one-off errors out of the list. Raise it when the list is still too long to scan; set it to 1 to see every error, including one that has happened only once so far. Nothing is hidden by this number — an error below it simply stays in Individual entries. Leave blank, or set it below 1, to use the default of 2.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many repeats before the console lists an error as a problem. Blank = the default of 2. Errors below this number still appear in Individual entries.
CustomField.label: Problem Grouping Minimum Occurrences
